title: Exclusive OR and De Morgan's laws
subtitle: Difference detection and equivalent gate transforms

learn.prompt: An XOR (Exclusive OR) gate outputs TRUE when its inputs differ. If Input A = 1 and Input B = 1, what does the XOR gate output?
learn.hint: Exclusive OR means 'one or the other, but NOT both'.
learn.explanation: Because both inputs are 1, they are identical, so XOR outputs 0 (FALSE).

misconceptionMap.true: A regular OR outputs 1 for (1, 1), but an Exclusive OR requires the inputs to be strictly different.
misconceptionMap.two: Logic outputs are binary: strictly 0 or 1.

learn.prompt: Configure inputs A and B so that an XOR gate outputs TRUE (1).
learn.hint: The inputs must be different from one another. Turn on either Input A or Input B, but not both.
learn.explanation: Setting Input A ON and Input B OFF produces an output of 1 from the XOR gate.

learn.prompt: According to De Morgan's Law, what is the logical equivalent of NOT(A AND B)?
learn.hint: Break the line, change the sign: negate each variable and swap AND for OR.
learn.explanation: NOT(A AND B) ≡ (NOT A) OR (NOT B). If it is not the case that both hold, then at least one must be false.

misconceptionMap.b: (NOT A) AND (NOT B) is equivalent to NOT(A OR B), not NOT(A AND B).
misconceptionMap.c: Inverting an AND does not yield a simple OR without inverting the operands.
misconceptionMap.d: NOT(A OR B) is a NOR gate.

learn.prompt: Evaluate the XOR sum (addition modulo 2): 1 ⊕ 0 ⊕ 1. Enter the single binary digit result (0 or 1).
learn.explanation: (1 ⊕ 0) = 1. Then (1 ⊕ 1) = 0. The parity of an even number of 1s is 0.

check.prompt: Why is the NAND gate known as a 'universal gate' in computer engineering?
check.hint: Consider what other logic functions can be built purely out of NAND gates.
check.explanation: Any Boolean function (NOT, AND, OR, XOR) can be constructed exclusively using arrangements of NAND gates. Modern flash memory and CPUs are built largely from NAND structures.

options.label: Any possible logic function or computer can be built entirely using only NAND gates
NAND gates use zero electrical power
NAND gates operate faster than the speed of light
NAND gates can take an infinite number of inputs

misconceptionMap.b: All physical semiconductor gates consume switching power.
misconceptionMap.c: Semiconductor propagation delays are limited by capacitance and light speed in silicon.
misconceptionMap.d: Physical gates have a maximum fan-in limit.

check.prompt: A two-way hallway light switch allows you to flip either switch to toggle the light state. Which logic operation governs this behavior?
check.hint: Flipping either switch inverts the output.
check.explanation: An XOR gate inverts its output whenever either input toggles state, exactly matching two-way light switching circuits.

misconceptionMap.and: An AND gate would turn off if either switch is turned off.
misconceptionMap.nor: A NOR gate is only on when both switches are off.
misconceptionMap.not: A NOT gate only accepts a single input.

takeaway.title: Universality and parity
takeaway.body: XOR acts as a difference detector and bit-adder (half adder). De Morgan's laws show that negation swaps conjunction and disjunction, proving that NAND and NOR are universal building blocks.
